decisions.statement: The values the file needs are named in one list.
A build told nothing for a needed value is refused.
The refusal names every value the build was told nothing for.
A file already holding the content wanted is left alone.
A file that will not open counts as holding something else.
The hash answered is of the content wanted rather than of the content the file has.
A hash is taken by the module that tells a self-write from a game write.
A write goes through the atomic write the retry module has.
A caller may hand in the disk that reads and writes the file.

definition: the inventory config file put beside the addon only where its content changed
